audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Use Sanguine Pool' in wants.foe[1] — this is a FALSE POSITIVE; Sanguine Pool is the correct current name of Vladimir's W.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling out of your combo, healing it all back with Transfusion, and outscaling you from behind his minions.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Petrifying Gaze has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5, and buys only 2 seconds of untargetability — bait it, then spend your window while it recharges. - Tides of Blood is 13s at rank 1 and minions block it. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s: save it for a pool-less Vladimir.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by anti-heal: Vladimir's whole plan is healing through your poison, so buy Grievous Wounds and your DoT simply wins.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Vladimir off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, take the wave to his tower, and buy anti-heal early — a Vladimir low on health with Sanguine Pool down cannot farm at all.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Vladimir is executable.
edits.after: Noxious Blast first — Twin Fang only hits hard on a poisoned target, costs 40 mana on a 0.75s cooldown, and heals you through his Transfusion drain.

edits.before: Vladimir spends Sanguine Pool early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Miasma slows the pool's exit — drop it on him as the 2 seconds end and he surfaces into fangs.

edits.before: That’s Vladimir’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Tides of Blood costs him health, not mana — free poke back is how he wins.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Unpoisoned Twin Fang costs the same 40 mana for a fraction of the damage — no Blast, no E, or you lose the mana war outright.

edits.before: Track Vladimir’s Sanguine Pool: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Sanguine Pool (28s at rank 1): 2 seconds untargetable eats your R. Bait it with Noxious Blast, then commit while it recharges.

edits.before: Your DoT stacking starts outracing his sustain from Crimson Pact scaling, and Liandry's burn especially punishes him since he has no hard escape besides the pool cooldown.
edits.after: Your DoT starts outracing his sustain here, but only with Grievous Wounds — Liandry's burn plus anti-heal punishes a Vladimir whose only escape is a 22-second pool.
